Coverage — literacy_pct: 26/26; sdg_index_score: 0/26; nfhs5_institutional_births_pct: 13/26; nfhs5_stunting_under5_pct: 13/26; nfhs5_infant_mortality: 0/26; udise_dropout_rate_secondary: 26/26; udise_pupil_teacher_ratio_primary: 0/26; mgnrega_persondays_fy25: 0/26; pmayg_houses_completed: 0/26; jjm_tap_connections: 26/26. Nulls carry explicit reasons in each indicator. Key caveats: literacy is Census 2011 recomputed for new-district geography by AP School Education Dept (Educational Statistics 2022-23); NFHS-5 (2019-21) predates the 2022 reorganization — 13 unchanged districts carry old-district values flagged with boundary notes, 13 new districts are null, and IMR is not published at district level by NFHS-5 at all; UDISE+ secondary dropout and JJM tap connections come from Lok Sabha question annexures covering all 26 districts; primary pupil-teacher ratio, MGNREGA person-days, and PMAY-G completions are district-unavailable via text-readable sources (JS/session dashboards) and are candidates for a live-browser pass; NITI Aayog has published no district-level SDG scores for AP. GeoJSON: verified 26-district MIT-licensed file found; 10 of 26 file names need display-name aliasing (documented in geojson.name_mismatches, incl. stale "Sri Balaji Dist." -> Tirupati).
